name: searchconsole
description: Google Search Console: connect with OAuth, submit the sitemap, inspect URLs and import daily search performance.

client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
client_id.description: From a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Web application.

client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: Stored here and never shown again.

public_url.title: Public address of this site
public_url.description: For example https://example.com. Google redirects back to <address>/p/searchconsole/oauth/callback; add that address to the OAuth client.

encryption_key.title: Token encryption key
encryption_key.description: Optional extra secret mixed into the key that encrypts the Google tokens at rest (with the client secret). Changing it or the client secret means connecting again.

import_days.title: Days of performance data to keep importing
